name: 5 Bucks for the Bus
summary: THE WORKING CLASS RPG. In this rpg you can only pick one class, the working class. Play as Paintricia, she used to paint art, then she painted walls, now she's stuck with no cash for the bus ride home. Wandering the giant liminal space that is "The City" things start to get weird.

name: 5buttons
summary:
Short one-screen point-and-click puzzle.

The puzzles are based on associations and have clear logic. Try to guess all 6 correct combinations.

Please note that the orange letters are clickable.

Made solo specifically for the Confounding Calendar 2025
